description: Manufactured CopilotChats schema. A CopilotChat is a single BizChat / Microsoft 365 Copilot conversation owned by one user, made up of alternating user prompts and Copilot answers. This is the persisted chat-history entity that Copilot's left-rail (GetChats) lists. Distinct from the Teams 'chats' entity.
title: CopilotChats

CopilotChat.description: A single Microsoft 365 Copilot conversation owned by one user.

ConversationId.description: An identifier for the conversation, useful for tracking and reference.

Title.description: The conversation title shown in the Copilot chat list (the left-rail history entry).

Owner.description: The user who owns the conversation. Usually the MailNickName of the user.

CreatedDateTime.description: Timestamp of when the conversation was created. This follows the ISO 8601 pattern.

LastModifiedDateTime.description: Timestamp of when the conversation was last modified. This follows the ISO 8601 pattern.

Messages.description: The ordered list of turns in the conversation, alternating user prompts and Copilot answers.

CopilotChatMessage.description: Represents an individual turn within a Copilot conversation.

MessageId.description: An identifier for each message, useful for tracking and reference.

Author.description: Who authored the turn. 'user' is the tenant user; 'copilot' is the Copilot assistant answer.

ContentType.description: The type of the content. Possible values are text and html.

CreatedDateTime.description: Timestamp of when the turn was created. This follows the ISO 8601 pattern.

GroundingReferences.description: Optional list of tenant grounding entities this turn is grounded in (e.g. the email or file the prompt refers to). Mirrors Sydney's sourceAttributions.

MessageType.description: Optional Sydney message classification, e.g. 'Answer', 'Progress', 'Context'. Mirrors Sydney's messageType. Optional — not required for replay.

RequestId.description: Optional Sydney request correlation id (GUID) for the turn. Mirrors Sydney's requestId. Optional — traceability only.

ResponseIdentifier.description: Optional Sydney response identifier for the turn. Mirrors Sydney's responseIdentifier. Optional — traceability only.

ContentOrigin.description: Optional origin of the answer content, e.g. 'DeepLeo'. Mirrors Sydney's contentOrigin. Optional.

SuggestedResponses.description: Optional list of Copilot follow-up suggestion strings shown beneath an answer. Mirrors Sydney's suggestedResponses. Optional.

AdaptiveCards.description: Optional rendered Adaptive Card payload(s) for the turn as produced by Sydney (adaptiveCards). Shape is intentionally open so card variations validate without a schema change. Optional.

Scores.description: Optional per-component scores Sydney attaches to an answer (e.g. relevance). Mirrors Sydney's scores. Optional.

GroundingReference.description: A reference to a tenant grounding entity that a Copilot turn draws on. Mirrors a single Sydney sourceAttribution: Type/Id identify the entity; the remaining optional fields carry Sydney's citation metadata so a full source attribution can be represented without a schema change.

Type.description: The grounding entity type, e.g. Email, File, Event, Meeting, ChatMessage, People. Mirrors sourceAttribution.type.

Id.description: The identifier of the referenced grounding entity (e.g. EmailId, FileId). Typically the EntityRepresentationId Sydney carries in seeMoreUrl.

SourceType.description: Optional Sydney attribution source class, e.g. 'ANNOTATION'. Mirrors sourceAttribution.sourceType. Optional.

DisplayName.description: Optional human-readable name of the referenced entity (extracted from sourceAttribution.metadata). Optional.

SeeMoreUrl.description: Optional deep link to the entity (carries the EntityRepresentationId). Mirrors sourceAttribution.seeMoreUrl. Optional.

Metadata.description: Optional raw metadata payload as Sydney serializes it (JSON string). Mirrors sourceAttribution.metadata. Optional.

MetadataState.description: Optional metadata state flag from Sydney. Mirrors sourceAttribution.metadataState. Optional.

IsHeroEntity.description: Optional flag: whether Sydney marked this as the hero (primary) entity. Mirrors sourceAttribution.isHeroEntity. Optional.

IsCitedInResponse.description: Optional flag: whether this attribution is actually cited in the answer text. Mirrors sourceAttribution.isCitedInResponse. Optional.

MessageScore.description: A single component score Sydney attaches to an answer. Mirrors an entry in Sydney's scores array.

MailNickNameOrEmail.description: User MailNickName or external full email address
